137	  messages: AiMessage[],
138	  system: string | undefined,
139	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
140	  signal?: AbortSignal,
141	): Promise<string> {
142	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
143	    method: 'POST',
144	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
145	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
146	    signal,
147	  })
148	  if (!res.ok) {
149	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
150	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
151	  }
152	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
153	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
154	  let buffer = ''
155	  let fullContent = ''
156	
157	  while (true) {
158	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
159	    if (done) break
160	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
161	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
162	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
163	    for (const line of parts) {
164	      const trimmed = line.trim()
165	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
166	      try {
167	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
168	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
169	          fullContent += event.content
170	          onChunk(event.content)
171	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
172	          fullContent = event.content
173	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
174	          throw new Error(event.error)
175	        }
176	      } catch (e) {
177	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
178	        throw e
179	      }
180	    }
181	  }
182	  return fullContent

3	export function useApi<T>(fetcher: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[] = []) {
4	  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null)
5	  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
6	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
7	
8	  const refetch = useCallback(() => {
9	    setLoading(true)
10	    setError(null)
11	    fetcher()
12	      .then(setData)
13	      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
14	      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
15	  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
16	  }, deps)
17	
18	  useEffect(() => {
19	    refetch()
20	  }, [refetch])
21	
22	  useEffect(() => {
23	    const handler = () => refetch()
24	    window.addEventListener('claude-hub:file-applied', handler)
25	    return () => window.removeEventListener('claude-hub:file-applied', handler)
26	  }, [refetch])
27	
28	  return { data, loading, error, refetch, setData }
29	}
